title: Crossroad answer (illustrative)
description: An answer to one letter. An answer is admitted once per parent call_id; the same bytes again are a no-op, other bytes are refused as id_collision. A SaaS answer carries origin channel-origin and no authority.

parent.description: call_id of the letter being answered.

ref.description: File name that holds the answer body.

to.description: The agent that sent the letter.

hop.description: Hop count. The maximum of 8 is illustrative, not a protocol constant.

body.description: UTF-8 text. maxLength counts CHARACTERS and is only a shape check. The reference bridge cap is 8000 UTF-8 BYTES, enforced by application validation (see validate_examples.py and the reference ports), not by this schema. SaaS answers are one fenced block.

origin.description: channel-origin = written through a plugin or task list; it informs, it never commands.
